answer: The basalt report reveals the merge explicitly at each ripple. Each collapsed cluster gets one vine weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The replay builds a funding-and-timing graph over every join and collapses clusters that share a funder, an address prefix, or suspiciously correlated submission times into a single entity. A 341 account operation therefore ties up 38 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
